card.name: Inside cyclooxygenase and mofetil names
card.fires_on: The middle of a drug or enzyme name, mainly 'xygen' in cyclooxygenase, 'X' in COX-2, and 'il' in mycophenolate mofetil. It appears in NSAID warnings and immunosuppressant lists.

modes.label: COX enzyme names
modes.description: Partway through cyclooxygenase or the abbreviation COX-2 in NSAID warnings.

modes.label: Mofetil ending
modes.description: The 'il' that completes mofetil in mycophenolate mofetil.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of the names cyclooxygenase, COX-2 and mycophenolate mofetil.
